大规模端到端上下文压缩End-to-End Context Compression at Scale

Ang Li    Sean McLeish    Haozhe Chen    Nimit Kalra    Zaiqian Chen    Artem Gazizov    Venkata Anoop Suhas Kumar Morisetty    Bhavya Kailkhura    Harshitha Menon    Zhuang Liu    Brian R. Bartoldson    Tom Goldstein    Sanae Lotfi    Micah Goldblum    Pavel Izmailov [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [
摘要Abstract

长上下文语言模型推理受到内存的瓶颈，因为 KV 缓存随着上下文长度而增长。最近压缩 KV 缓存的技术存在不足：它们要么大幅降低模型质量，要么需要大量时间和计算来压缩单个长提示。此外，许多方法要求输入适合目标模型的上下文窗口，并且通常与现代生产推理引擎不兼容。编码器-解码器压缩器将长令牌序列映射到解码器使用的较短的潜在嵌入序列，原则上是一种有吸引力的替代方案。然而，现有的方法在精度-效率方面与 KV 缓存压缩不具有竞争力。在这项工作中，我们重新审视编码器-解码器压缩并缩小这一差距。我们首先进行架构搜索，从头开始预训练许多变体，以确定如何最好地设计和训练编码器-解码器压缩器。在我们的研究结果的指导下，我们不断地以 1:4、1:8 和 1:16 的压缩比对超过 350B 个令牌上的一系列 0.6B 编码器、4B 解码器模型进行预训练。我们介绍Long-context language model inference is bottlenecked by memory, as the KV cache grows with context length. Recent techniques to compress the KV cache fall short: they either degrade model quality substantially or require considerable time and compute to compress a single long prompt. Furthermore, many methods require the input to fit within the target model’s context window, and are generally incompatible with modern production inference engines. Encoder-decoder compressors, which map a long token sequence to a shorter sequence of latent embeddings consumed by a decoder, are an appealing alternative in principle. However, existing approaches are not competitive with KV cache compression on the accuracy-efficiency frontier. In this work, we revisit encoder-decoder compression and close this gap. We first perform an architecture search, pre-training many variants from scratch to determine how best to design and train encoder-decoder compressors. Guided by our findings, we continually pre-train a family of 0.6B-encoder, 4B-decoder models on over 350B tokens each, at compression ratios of 1:4, 1:8, and 1:16. We introduce潜在语境语言模型Latent Context Language Models(LCLM)，一个压缩器系列，可改善一般任务性能、压缩速度和峰值内存使用的帕累托前沿。我们证明 LCLM 可以作为长视野智能体的有效骨干，让智能体浏览压缩的长上下文并根据需要自适应地扩展相关部分。(LCLMs), a family of compressors that improve the Pareto frontier across general-task performance, compression speed, and peak memory usage. We demonstrate that LCLMs serve as efficient backbones for long-horizon agents, letting the agent skim through a compressed long context and adaptively expand relevant segments on demand.

1 简介Introduction

对长上下文进行推理是最先进的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的一项关键功能，因为它使它们能够解析长文档、参与多轮对话以及执行长期代理任务。然而，在生产系统中，输入上下文、工作范围和内存可能会增长到数百万个令牌，由于 KV 缓存的增长，推理越来越受到内存和延迟的限制Reasoning over long contexts is a crucial capability for state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs), as it enables them to parse long documents, engage in multi-turn conversations, and perform long-horizon agentic tasks. However, in production systems, the input context, working horizon, and memory can grow to millions of tokens, making inference increasingly constrained by memory and latency due to the growth of the KV cache(Hooper et al., 2024)。 即使输入适合模型的最大上下文窗口，模型通常也很难可靠地使用分布在长上下文中的信息. Even when inputs fit within the model’s maximum context window, models often struggle to reliably use information distributed across long contexts(Liu et al., 2024b; An et al., 2025)。因此，上下文和内存管理已成为部署长期 LLM 系统的关键系统和建模挑战。. As a result, context and memory management have emerged as critical systems and modeling challenges for deploying long-horizon LLM systems.

一个自然的反应是直接减少KV缓存的大小。 KV 缓存压缩方法通过逐出缓存条目来减少缓存激活的内存占用A natural response is to reduce the size of the KV cache directly. KV cache compression methods reduce the memory footprint of cached activations by evicting cache entries(Li et al., 2024c; Devoto et al., 2025; Kim et al., 2025; Zweiger et al., 2026)或离线训练紧凑缓存or training a compact cache offline(Eyuboglu et al., 2025)。 然而，它们对于一般的长上下文推理有重要的局限性。 许多方法仍然需要在压缩之前预填充完整的上下文，并且有些方法需要超出原始预填充的大量额外时间或内存。 依赖于查询的方法产生的缓存难以跨轮重用. However, they have important limitations for general long-context inference. Many methods still require the full context to be prefilled before compression, and some require substantial additional time or memory beyond the original prefill. Query-dependent methods produce caches that are difficult to reuse across turns(Li et al., 2024b)，而跨注意力头和层逐出非均匀缓存的方法, while methods that evict caches non-uniformly across attention heads and layers(Kim et al., 2025)很难与假设跨缓存共享序列长度的现代推理引擎集成。are difficult to integrate with modern inference engines that assume a shared sequence length across the cache.

编码器-解码器软令牌方法Encoder-decoder soft-token methods(e.g. Lin et al., 2025; Ge et al., 2023; Chevalier et al., 2023; Liao et al., 2025; Yen et al., 2024)提供了一种有前途的方法来解决 KV 缓存压缩的局限性。这些模型不是直接操作 KV 缓存，而是将原始输入标记编码为更短的连续嵌入序列，然后将其提供给 LLM 代替原来的上下文。 原则上，这种方法非常有吸引力：压缩是可并行的，由标准 LLM 推理引擎支持，并且 与标准 LLM 解码配合使用，同时将解码器扩展到远远超出其本机上下文长度。offer a promising way to address the limitations of KV cache compression. Rather than manipulating the KV cache directly, these models encode the raw input tokens into a much shorter sequence of continuous embeddings, which are then provided to the LLM in place of the original context. In principle, this approach is highly attractive: compression is parallelizable, supported by standard LLM inference engines, and works with standard LLM decoding while extending the decoder far beyond its native context length.

然而，现有的软令牌压缩方法通常面临一个权衡：它们要么大大降低基础语言模型的能力，要么依赖特定领域的训练来保持有效。 这引发了一个基本问题：However, existing soft-token compression methods typically face a trade-off: they either substantially degrade the capabilities of the base language model or depend on domain-specific training to remain effective. This motivates a fundamental question:我们可以训练一个通用的、与任务无关的压缩器来保留模型的原始功能吗？can we train a general, task-agnostic compressor that preserves a model’s original capabilities?为此，我们介绍To this end, we introduce潜在语境语言模型Latent Context Language Models（LCLM），一系列经过大规模端到端训练的编码器-解码器压缩器。 我们使用预训练模型初始化编码器和解码器，并针对组合的编码器-解码器联合训练最多 350B 个令牌。 至关重要的是，我们证明 LCLM 可以保持解码器性能，同时减少用于输入上下文的内存。(LCLMs), a family of encoder-decoder compressors trained end-to-end at scale. We initialize both the encoder and decoder with pre-trained models and jointly train them on up to a total of 350B tokens for the combined encoder-decoder. Crucially, we demonstrate that LCLMs can preserve decoder performance while reducing memory used for input context.

我们的贡献总结如下：Our contributions are summarized as follows:

  1. 1.

    训练配方：Training recipe:我们为编码器-解码器上下文压缩开发了细粒度的训练方法。因此，我们为训练压缩器策划持续的预训练和微调数据，并优化多个训练阶段的训练细节。参见We develop a fine-grained training recipe for encoder-decoder context compression. Accordingly, we curate continual pre-training and finetuning data for training compressors and optimize training details across multiple training stages. SeeSection˜4.

  2. 2.

    综合架构搜索：Comprehensive architectural search:我们进行大规模架构搜索，以确定受控设置中编码器-解码器压缩模型的最佳设计选择。参见We conduct a large-scale architecture search to identify optimal design choices for encoder-decoder compression models in a controlled setting. SeeSection˜5和andFigure˜3.

  3. 3.

    新的内存/速度性能前沿：New memory/speed-performance frontier:我们大规模训练一系列不同压缩比的模型。我们的实验确定了有效平衡内存、延迟和下游准确性的帕累托前沿。我们开源了这套模型和所有代码。参见We train a family of models across different compression ratios at scale. Our experiments identify a Pareto frontier that effectively balances memory, latency, and downstream accuracy. We open-source this suite of models and all code. SeeSection˜6和andFigures˜1, 4和and5.

  4. 4.

    具有潜在上下文的代理：Agent with latent context:我们创建一个具有高压缩比的代理系统，代理可以选择要扩展的压缩块。这种代理工具极大地提高了模型在具有挑战性的大海捞针任务中的性能。参见We create an agentic system with a high compression ratio, where the agent can select which compressed chunk to expand. This agentic harness substantially enhances the model’s performance on challenging needle-in-the-haystack tasks. SeeSection˜7和andFigure˜6.

2 相关工作Related Work

上下文压缩方法通常分为三类：硬令牌、软令牌和 KV 缓存压缩。 我们推迟对硬令牌方法的讨论Context compression approaches generally fall into three categories: hard-token, soft-token, and KV cache compression. We defer the discussion of hard-token approaches toAppendix˜B，因为与后两者相比，它们通常表现不佳。, since they generally underperform compared to the latter two.

KV缓存压缩。KV cache compression.KV 缓存压缩方法从 KV 缓存中逐出条目。大多数方法依赖于手工设计或学习的启发式方法来选择要删除的条目。KV cache compression methods evict entries from the KV cache. Most methods rely on hand-crafted or learned heuristics to select which entries to drop.

与提示无关的方法Prompt-agnostic methods(Kim et al., 2025; Devoto et al., 2025; Zweiger et al., 2026)在不知道查询的情况下修剪上下文，而依赖于提示的方法（例如 SnapKV）prune the context without knowledge of the query, whereas prompt-dependent methods such as SnapKV(Li et al., 2024c)需要显式的上下文提示对并产生限制多轮适用性的特定于查询的缓存require explicit context-prompt pairs and yield query-specific caches that limit multi-turn applicability(Li et al., 2024b; Kim et al., 2025)。 另一种方法是在压缩时预测未来的查询：墨盒. An alternative is to anticipate future queries at compression time: Cartridges(Eyuboglu et al., 2025)为每个语料库提取固定大小的 KV 缓存。 然而，每个语料库的训练成本很高，ICL 质量的缓存在 8 台机器上需要大约 30 分钟。distills a fixed-size KV cache per corpus. However, this comes at a substantial training cost per corpus, with an ICL-quality cache requiring approximately 30 minutes on an 8×\times8B 型号的 H100 节点。H100 node for an 8B model.

尽管 KV 缓存压缩方法已得到充分研究，但在 vLLM 等推理引擎中并未广泛采用Although KV cache compression methods are well-studied, they are not widely adopted in inference engines such as vLLM(Kwon et al., 2023)或 SGLangor SGLang(Zheng et al., 2024)。 KVzip 等压缩方法在注意力头和层之间不均匀地分配驱逐预算；因此，它们无法减少KV缓存的序列长度维度。相反，KV 缓存压缩方法掩盖了注意力计算中被逐出的位置，从而丧失了这些分页注意力引擎的内存和吞吐量优势。有些方法还需要比原始输入长两到三倍的预填充通道. Compression methods such as KVzip allocate eviction budgets non-uniformly across attention heads and layers; therefore, they cannot reduce the sequence-length dimension of the KV cache. Instead, KV cache compression methods mask evicted positions in the attention computation, forfeiting the memory and throughput benefits of these paged-attention engines. Some methods further require prefill passes that are two to three times longer than the original input(Kim et al., 2025)。 我们注意到软令牌压缩方法与这些开源推理框架完全兼容。. We note that soft token compression methods are fully compatible with these open-source inference frameworks.

软令牌压缩。Soft-token compression.尽管结果有希望，但大多数先前的软令牌方法都依赖于离线预处理，并且不能令人信服地保留基本模型的广泛上下文行为。 先前的工作主要是在特定于领域或任务的微调上进行评估，这些微调不可跨任务转移Despite promising results, most prior soft-token methods rely on offline preprocessing and do not convincingly preserve the base model’s broad in-context behavior. Prior work is mostly evaluated on domain- or task-specific finetuning that is not transferable across tasks(Tang et al., 2025; Feldman and Artzi, 2025; Dai et al., 2025; Lin et al., 2025; Cheng et al., 2024)。 据我们所知，这些方法并未在具有信息密集型任务的长上下文基准上进行评估，这些任务需要整个上下文中的细粒度细节，例如 RULER. To the best of our knowledge, these methods are not evaluated on long-context benchmarks with information-dense tasks that require fine-grained details throughout the whole context, such as RULER(Hsieh et al., 2024)，展示复杂的长上下文理解。, to demonstrate complex long-context understanding.

In Section˜5，我们讨论了先前关于软令牌压缩的工作的架构决策，作为我们架构搜索和分析的一部分。 我们的工作表明，通过大规模分阶段训练，单个在线软令牌压缩器可以稳健地处理一般的异构输入，同时紧密匹配未压缩的行为。, we discuss the architectural decisions of prior work on soft-token compression as part of our architectural search and analysis. Our work shows that, with large-scale staged training, a single online soft-token compressor can robustly handle general heterogeneous inputs while closely matching uncompressed behavior.

4 训练食谱Training Recipe

我们现在描述我们的多阶段训练方法和数据。 与之前在小规模域内数据集上训练专门模型的上下文压缩工作相比We now describe our multi-stage recipe and data for training. In contrast to prior context-compression work that trains specialized models on small-scale in-domain datasets(Tang et al., 2025; Feldman and Artzi, 2025; Pilchen et al., 2025; Cheng et al., 2024; Liao et al., 2025)，我们的目标是保持强大的法学硕士在下游任务中的强劲表现。为此，我们策划了三种类型的数据：持续预训练数据、监督微调（SFT）数据和辅助重建数据。, our goal is to preserve the strong performance of a powerful LLM across downstream tasks. To this end, we curate three types of data: continual pre-training data, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) data, and auxiliary reconstruction data.

4.1 训练数据Training Data

持续预训练数据集。Continual pre-training dataset.

我们构建了一个精心策划的高质量预训练混合物，涵盖 Common Crawl 文本、代码、科学和推理、长上下文数据和指令式数据。 我们将每个序列划分为多个段，并在压缩段和标准令牌段之间交替。 然后我们计算未压缩令牌的下一个令牌预测损失We construct a carefully curated high-quality pre-training mixture covering Common Crawl text, code, science and reasoning, long-context data, and instruction-style data. We partition each sequence into multiple segments and alternate between compressed segments and standard token segments. We then compute the next-token prediction loss on the uncompressed tokens仅only。这种交错格式不同于先前工作中使用的简单的前半部分压缩、后半部分可训练分割. This interleaved format differs from the simple first-half compressed, second-half trainable split used in prior work(Lin et al., 2025; Ge et al., 2023; Chevalier et al., 2023; Yen et al., 2024)。通过在整个序列中分布压缩跨度，模型学习在多个位置而不是仅在上下文的开头以潜在上下文为条件。我们提供了这种数据格式的直观示例. By distributing compressed spans throughout the sequence, the model learns to condition on latent context at multiple positions rather than only at the beginning of the context. We provide a visual example of this data format inFigure˜2。确切的预训练混合物描述于. The exact pre-training mixture is described inSection˜C.1，以及有关压缩格式的更多详细信息, with additional details on compression formatting inSection˜C.4.

SFT 数据。SFT data.

持续预训练后恢复性能To recover performance after continual pre-training(Gao et al., 2025)为了进一步增强具有潜在上下文的指令跟踪能力，我们进一步通过监督微调对模型进行后训练，以在压缩输入条件下提高推理、指令跟踪和长上下文理解。 我们构建了一个涵盖三个部分的 SFT 混合物：(i) 推理，(ii) 长上下文指令遵循，以及 (iii) 一般指令遵循和多轮对话。原始 SFT 数据中的一些补全是由过时的模型生成的。为了提高响应质量，我们使用以下方法重新标记 SFT 数据的子集and further enhance instruction following capability with latent context, we further post-train the model with supervised fine-tuning to improve reasoning, instruction following, and long-context understanding when conditioning on compressed inputs. We construct an SFT mixture spanning three components: (i) reasoning, (ii) long-context instruction following, and (iii) general instruction following and multi-turn conversation. Some completions in the original SFT data were generated by outdated models. To improve response quality, we relabel a subset of the SFT data usingQwen3-30B-A3B-指令-2507Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507和andQwen3-235B-A22B-指令-2507Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507，其模型检查点是在 Apache-2.0 许可证下发布的。我们报告了确切的 SFT 混合物和其他详细信息, whose model checkpoints are released under the Apache-2.0 license. We report the exact SFT mixture and other details inSection˜C.3.

辅助重建数据。Auxiliary reconstruction data.

为了加速训练并鼓励潜在表示保留细粒度信息，我们引入了辅助重建任务。给定一个样本文档，我们压缩文本并要求模型重复原始内容。为了增加多样性，我们提供了各种来源，涵盖代码、文本、长文档、数学和To accelerate training and encourage the latent representations to preserve fine-grained information, we introduce an auxiliary reconstruction task. Given a sampled document, we compress the text and ask the model to repeat the original content. To increase diversity, we include a variety of sources spanning code, text, long documents, math, andLaTeX，如中所述, as described inSection˜C.2。为了减少即时过度拟合，我们使用了一组. To reduce prompt overfitting, we use a bank of100100每个来源的提示模板。此辅助任务鼓励压缩器不仅支持语义理解，而且保留精确检索等任务所需的细粒度细节。我们在持续预训练和 SFT 中都包含了辅助重建数据。prompt templates per source. This auxiliary task encourages the compressor not only to support semantic understanding but also to retain fine-grained details needed for tasks such as exact retrieval. We include auxiliary reconstruction data in both continual pre-training and SFT.

4.2 训练阶段Training Stages

我们采用多阶段训练方法来提高稳定性、保留原始模型的功能并减少灾难性遗忘。这些阶段逐渐增加可训练组件的数量，从适配器和编码器预热开始，然后是端到端持续预训练和 SFT。We adopt a multi-stage training recipe to improve stability, preserve the original model’s capabilities, and mitigate catastrophic forgetting. The stages progressively increase the number of trainable components, starting with adapter and encoder warm up, followed by end-to-end continual pre-training and SFT.

  • •

    第 0 阶段：适配器预热。Stage 0: Adapter warmup.我们冻结编码器和解码器并仅更新适配器。We freeze both the encoder and decoder and update only the adapter.

  • •

    第一阶段：编码器训练。Stage 1: Encoder training.我们解冻编码器，同时保持解码器冻结。We unfreeze the encoder while keeping the decoder frozen.

  • •

    第 2 阶段：端到端持续预训练。Stage 2: End-to-end continual pre-training.我们以较小的学习率解冻解码器。We unfreeze the decoder with a small learning rate.

  • •

    第三阶段：监督微调。Stage 3: Supervised fine-tuning.我们对 SFT 混合物进行训练并提高解码器的学习率。We train on the SFT mixture and increase the decoder learning rate.

此分阶段过程类似于视觉语言模型 (VLM) 训练管道，首先跨模态对齐预训练的表示This staged procedure is analogous to Vision-Language Model (VLM) training pipelines that first align pre-trained representations across modalities(Liu et al., 2023a; Tong et al., 2024)然后针对下游任务进行微调。对于阶段 0、1 和 2，我们从连续预训练混合物中均匀采样；在第 3 阶段，我们使用 SFT 混合物进行训练。在早期的实验中，我们考虑从一开始就直接端到端地训练完整的模型，但发现这种方法的性能不如多阶段配方。在训练开始时，解码器不习惯接收嵌入模型的输出，因此编码器和解码器参数梯度都可能很大，导致模型退化。在分阶段方法中，我们首先在解冻编码器和解码器之前训练适配器，这样可以保持梯度平滑并使训练更加稳定，从而防止这种退化。因此，我们对所有规模实验均采用多阶段配方。我们还考虑了参数有效的变体，使解码器完全冻结and then fine-tune for downstream tasks. For stages 0, 1, and 2, we uniformly sample from the continual pre-training mixture; for stage 3, we train on the SFT mixture. In early experiments, we consider directly training the full model end-to-end from the beginning, but find that this approach underperforms the multi-stage recipe. At the beginning of training, the decoder is not accustomed to taking in the output of the embedding model, so both encoder and decoder parameter gradients can be large, leading to model degradation. The staged approach, where we first train the adapter before unfreezing the encoder and decoder, keeps gradients smooth and training more stable, preventing this degradation. We therefore adopt the multi-stage recipe for all scaled experiments. We also consider parameter-efficient variants that keep the decoder fully frozen(Ge et al., 2023; Cheng et al., 2024; Yen et al., 2024)或使用LoRAor use LoRA(Liao et al., 2025; Tang et al., 2025; Feldman and Artzi, 2025)，但我们发现与早期实验中的全参数训练相比，它们的表现明显较差；因此，我们专注于端到端培训。连续预训练和 SFT 数据混合的详细信息在, but we find them to substantially underperform compared to full-parameter training in early experiments; we therefore focus on end-to-end training. Details of the continual pre-training and SFT data mixtures are provided inTable˜2和andTable˜3，分别。所有其他训练细节，包括令牌预算、学习率和序列长度，均在, respectively. All other training details, including token budgets, learning rates, and sequence lengths, are provided inTable˜1.

5 潜在编码器的架构设计空间Architectural Design Space of Latent Encoders

我们通过从头开始预训练 LCLM 变体，对编码器-解码器上下文压缩器进行受控架构搜索。我们的洁净室设置使我们能够隔离架构选择的影响，而不会与预先训练的初始化相混淆。这对于诸如编码器注意掩模和池化运算符之类的选择尤其重要：例如，预训练的We conduct a controlled architecture search over encoder-decoder context compressors by pre-training LCLM variants from scratch. Our cleanroom setting lets us isolate the effect of architectural choices without confounding from pre-trained initialization. This is particularly important for choices such as the encoder attention mask and pooling operators: for example, the pre-trainedQwen3-Embedding-0.6B编码器使用因果注意力和 EOS 池化，这可能会使架构搜索产生偏差。具体来说，我们使用encoder uses causal attention and EOS pooling, which could bias the architectural search. Specifically, we useQwen3-0.6B作为编码器和解码器的基础架构，使用相同的种子随机初始化所有权重，并在没有冻结参数的情况下端到端地训练所有组件。每个变体都在中描述的预训练混合物上进行训练as the base architecture for both the encoder and decoder, randomly initializing all weights with the same seed, and training all components end-to-end with no frozen parameters. Each variant is trained on the pre-training mixture described inSection˜4对于压缩比为 38B 的令牌for 38B tokens at a compression ratioN=16N=16。这种全面的搜索涵盖了先前软令牌压缩工作中探索的几乎所有主要架构选择，以及其他尚未探索的选择。我们在下面描述每个设计轴及其经验效果。. This comprehensive search covers nearly all major architectural choices explored in prior soft-token compression work, along with additional underexplored choices. We describe each design axis and its empirical effect below.

池化运算符。Pooling operator.

先前有关上下文压缩的工作主要集中在两种池化策略上。 基于令牌的池附加或前置指定的令牌，例如Prior work on context compression has primarily focused on two pooling strategies. Token-based pooling appends or prepends designated tokens, such asEOS or CLS，并使用它们的最终隐藏状态作为压缩表示, and uses their final hidden states as compressed representations(Lin et al., 2025; Liao et al., 2025; Chevalier et al., 2023)。 平均池化对每个块上的编码器隐藏状态进行平均. Mean pooling averages encoder hidden states over each block ofNN输入标记input tokens(Ge et al., 2023; Tang et al., 2025)，一种常见于视觉和多模态模型的设计, a design that is common in vision and multimodal models(DeepMind, 2026)。 我们还考虑了串联，这是视觉风格架构中广泛使用的替代方案，但在上下文压缩方面的探索较少. We additionally consider concatenation, a widely used alternative in vision-style architectures but less explored for context compression(Qwen Team, 2025; Tong et al., 2024)。串联保留了. Concatenation preserves theNN顺序编码器隐藏状态通过将它们堆叠到单个宽向量中，之后适配器将结果表示投影回 LLM 隐藏维度。池化运算符的正式定义可以在sequential encoder hidden states by stacking them into a single wide vector, after which the adapter projects the resulting representation back to the LLM hidden dimension. The formal definitions of pooling operators can be found inSection˜D.1.

Figure˜3比较我们预训练扫描中的三个池化运算符。与基于令牌的池化相比，均值池化始终改善了预训练损失，但从经验上看与串联无法区分。这与之前的证据一致，即均值池的压缩性能优于基于令牌的池compares the three pooling operators in our pre-training sweep. Mean pooling consistently improves pre-training loss over token-based pooling, but is empirically indistinguishable from concatenation. This agrees with prior evidence that mean pooling can outperform token-based pooling for compression(Feldman and Artzi, 2025)，并且研究结果表明，尽管在文本嵌入模型中是一种有损操作，但均值池仍然可以非常有效, and with findings that mean pooling can be surprisingly effective despite being a lossy operation in text embedding models(Hara et al., 2026)。这也与视觉架构中的相关观察结果一致. It is also consistent with related observations in vision architectures(Chu et al., 2021)。虽然串联原则上可以保留意味着损失的不同表示，并且已发现在其他表示学习设置中优于均值池. While concatenation can, in principle, preserve distinct representations that mean loses, and has been found to outperform mean pooling in other representation-learning settings(Chen et al., 2025)，我们在小规模实验中没有观察到这种优势。我们大规模比较这两个运算符, we do not observe this advantage in our small-scale experiment. We compare these two operators at scale inFigures˜8和andG.4.1，其中串联在低压缩比下优于平均池，而平均池在高压缩比下优于串联，而两者之间的差距随着上下文长度的增加而缩小。, where concatenation outperforms mean pooling at low compression ratios and mean pooling outperforms concatenation at high compression ratios, while the gap between the two narrows as context length increases.

编码粒度。Encoding granularity.

理想情况下，将编码器窗口大小设置为完整的上下文长度，允许编码器联合上下文化所有输入标记，类似于 ViT 风格的编码器Ideally, one would set the encoder window size to the full context length, allowing the encoder to jointly contextualize all input tokens, analogous to ViT-style encoders(Dosovitskiy et al., 2020)一次处理整个图像。然而，对于语言输入，上下文长度可能会更大，这使得全上下文编码在内存和时间上都令人望而却步。that process the entire image at once. For language inputs, however, the context length can be substantially larger, making full-context encoding prohibitive in both memory and time.

为了研究这种权衡，我们改变编码器窗口大小To study this trade-off, we vary the encoder window size overW∈{N,256,1024}W\in\{N,256,1024\}用于平均池化for mean pooling inFigure˜3。我们发现增加. We find that increasingWW来自fromN​(16)N\;(16) (Lin et al., 2025; Liao et al., 2025) to 256256带来很大的改善，同时增加leads to a large improvement, while increasingWW距离更远further from256256 to 10241024产生额外的较小增益。自从yields an additional smaller gain. SinceW=1024W=1024在我们的设置中不会引入显着的内存或运行时开销，我们采用does not introduce significant memory or runtime overhead in our setting, we adoptW=1024W=1024作为默认值。此设置使编码器能够参与更大的本地上下文并生成更丰富的压缩表示。使用限制之一as the default. This setting enables the encoder to attend over a larger local context and produce richer compressed representations. One limitation of usingW<TW<T是输入必须被分块到多个窗口中，因此跨越边界的信息被分成两个编码器前向传递。为了解决这个问题，我们还设计了一种边界重叠变体，允许每个窗口在编码期间看到相邻的标记。然而，这种方法在增加编码器计算量的同时并不能改善预训练损失，因此我们默认不使用重叠，并将细节推迟到is that the input must be chunked into multiple windows, so information crossing a boundary is split across two encoder forward passes. To address this, we also design a boundary-overlap variant that allows each window to see neighboring tokens during encoding. However, this approach does not improve pre-training loss while increasing encoder compute, so we use no overlap by default and defer details toSection˜D.3.

编码器注意掩模。Encoder attention mask.

与标准解码器语言建模不同，标准解码器语言建模需要因果屏蔽来匹配自回归推理，而上下文压缩在解码之前应用于提示。因此，编码器可以使用因果注意力或双向注意力，如前缀 LM 中那样Unlike standard decoder language modeling, where causal masking is required to match autoregressive inference, context compression is applied to the prompt before decoding. The encoder can therefore use either causal or bidirectional attention, as in prefix-LMs(Raffel et al., 2020)。在. InFigures˜3和and9，我们比较这两种掩蔽选择，发现因果掩蔽始终实现较低的预训练损失。, we compare these two masking choices and find that causal masking consistently achieves lower pre-training loss.

适配器设计。Adapter design.

适配器从维度投影编码器潜伏The adapter projects encoder latents from dimensiondencd_{\mathrm{enc}}到解码器嵌入维度to the decoder embedding dimensionddecd_{\mathrm{dec}}。先前的编码器-解码器压缩工作通常假设编码器和解码器隐藏大小相匹配，但各种编码器-解码器模型将较小的编码器与较大的解码器配对，这使得适配器成为一个重要的设计选择。我们将轻量级 MLP 投影与基于注意力的适配器进行比较，后者在 MLP 投影之前的潜在序列上添加了一个自注意力层。与之前的发现相比. Prior encoder-decoder compression work often assumes matching encoder and decoder hidden sizes, but a wide range of encoder-decoder models pair smaller encoders with larger decoders, making the adapter a non-trivial design choice. We compare a lightweight MLP projection against an attention-based adapter that adds a single self-attention layer over the latent sequence before the MLP projection. In contrast to prior findings(Tang et al., 2025)，我们观察到, we observe inFigure˜9仅 MLP 适配器在使用较少计算的情况下实现了较低的预训练损失，因此我们采用它作为默认值。正式定义见that the MLP-only adapter achieves lower pre-training loss while using less compute, and we adopt it as the default. Formal definitions are provided inSection˜D.2.

大规模的最佳架构。Optimal architecture at scale.

总的来说，我们从头开始的预训练实验Overall, our from-scratch pre-training experiments inFigure˜3作为轻量级架构扫描，使我们能够将搜索空间缩小到一组较小的有前途的设计选择。然后，我们使用完整的训练管道来扩展这些候选者，既可以确定规模上最强的架构，也可以验证小规模预训练结果在大规模训练下仍然具有预测性。对于我们的主要实验，我们使用serve as a lightweight architecture sweep, allowing us to narrow the search space to a smaller set of promising design choices. We then scale these candidates using the full training pipeline, both to identify the strongest architecture at scale and to validate that the small-scale pre-training findings remain predictive under large-scale training. 6 结果：改善延迟和内存性能权衡Results: Improving Latency- and Memory-Performance Tradeoffs

我们主要关注长上下文基准：我们在 RULER 上进行评估We predominantly focus on long-context benchmarks: we evaluate on RULER(Hsieh et al., 2024), 长凳, LongBench(Bai et al., 2024)、和长期健康, and LongHealth(Adams et al., 2025)。 对于长上下文评估套件，我们将指令维护为未压缩的标记，同时压缩长上下文段。 我们报告每个基准测试的哪些部分被压缩，哪些部分作为标准未压缩标记保留在. For the long-context evaluation suite, we maintain instructions as uncompressed tokens, while we compress long-context segments. We report which parts of each benchmark are compressed and which are left as standard uncompressed tokens inTable˜5.

我们测量两个效率轴：压缩期间的峰值内存和压缩时间。 峰值内存包括每个上下文长度的单个样本的编码器和解码器。 我们报告了同一 H200 GPU 上超过 30 次测量的平均值，使用 20 个预热步骤来减少内核级噪声。 我们将压缩时间定义为第一个令牌时间（TTFT），即方法到达可以生成第一个令牌的点所需的时间。 我们调整了 KVPressWe measure two efficiency axes: peak memory during compression, and compression time. Peak memory includes both the encoder and decoder for a single sample at each context length. We report the mean over 30 measurements on the same H200 GPU, using 20 warmup steps to reduce kernel-level noise. We define compression time as time-to-first-token (TTFT), i.e., the time required for a method to reach the point at which it can generate the first token. We adapt the KVPress(Devoto et al., 2025)计时码timing code111https://github.com/NVIDIA/kvpress/blob/main/notebooks/speed_and_memory.ipynb来支持我们的方法。 所有方法均使用 Hugging Face Transformers 进行基准测试to support our method. All methods are benchmarked using Hugging Face Transformers(Wolf et al., 2020)实施。implementations.

由于 LCLM 在编码器窗口块中处理输入令牌，因此我们可以通过在将生成的软令牌传递给解码器之前批处理编码器前向传递来并行压缩。 对于本文中的所有图形，我们使用的编码器批量大小为Since LCLMs process input tokens in encoder-window chunks, we can parallelize compression by batching encoder forward passes before passing the resulting soft tokens to the decoder. For all figures in this paper, we use an encoder batch size of128128;与编码器窗口尺寸; with encoder window sizeW=1024W=1024，这对应于处理, this corresponds to processing131,072131{,}072每个批处理编码器传递的输入令牌。 我们发现这个批量大小在压缩速度和编码器内存使用之间提供了良好的权衡，提高了 GPU 利用率，而不会超出超长上下文的内存限制。 此外，由于我们的方法保留了标准的 KV 缓存结构，因此可以使用 vLLM 等标准推理框架进一步加速预填充和生成input tokens per batched encoder pass. We find this batch size provides a good trade-off between compression speed and encoder memory usage, improving GPU utilization without exceeding memory limits for ultra-long contexts. Moreover, because our method preserves the standard KV cache structure, prefill and generation can be further accelerated with standard inference frameworks such as vLLM(Kwon et al., 2023)和SGLangand SGLang(Zheng et al., 2024)，以及有效的注意力实现, as well as efficient attention implementations(Katharopoulos et al., 2020; Team et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2024a; DeepSeek-AI, 2026)。 因此，这里报告的吞吐量测量相对于优化服务实现可以实现的结果来说是保守的。. Therefore, the throughput measurements reported here are conservative relative to what optimized serving implementations could achieve.

6.1 基线Baselines

我们考虑一系列 KV 缓存压缩基线，包括预期注意力We consider a range of KV cache compression baselines, including Expected Attention(Devoto et al., 2025), 注意力匹配, Attention Matching(Zweiger et al., 2026), 压缩包, KVzip(Kim et al., 2025), FastKVzip (Kim et al., 2026)和 SnapKV, and SnapKV(Li et al., 2024c)。每种方法对查询感知、查询无关和自学压缩配置都有不同的本机支持。. Each method has different native support for query-aware, query-agnostic, and self-study compression configurations.

查询感知方法，例如 SnapKV，旨在压缩给定已知查询的上下文；然而，生成的压缩缓存可能无法很好地推广到未见过的查询或未来的查询。与查询无关的方法（例如 KVzip 和 FastKVzip）在不访问下游查询的情况下压缩缓存，通常使用重建式目标（例如重复原始上下文）。自学，如介绍Query-aware methods, such as SnapKV, are designed to compress a context given a known query; however, the resulting compressed cache may not generalize well to unseen queries or future turns. Query-agnostic methods, such as KVzip and FastKVzip, compress a cache without access to the downstream query, often using reconstruction-style objectives such as repeating the original context. Self-study, as introduced byEyuboglu et al. (2025)，使用合成查询执行压缩，以扩大潜在推理时间查询的覆盖范围。这些综合查询通常是通过提示目标解码器生成有关上下文的问题来生成的。注意力匹配, performs compression using synthetic queries to expand coverage over potential inference-time queries. These synthetic queries are typically produced by prompting the target decoder to generate questions about the context. In Attention Matching(Zweiger et al., 2026)，作者尝试了混合查询不可知和自学配置，发现自学对重复预填充提示的影响有限。由于自学习引入了额外的压缩时间开销，因此我们不将其应用于 RULER。, the authors experiment with a mixed query-agnostic and self-study configuration and find that self-study has limited impact on the repeat-prefill prompt. Since self-study introduces additional compression-time overhead, we do not apply it to RULER.

区分算法和理论缓存减少与系统可实现的缓存减少也很重要。一些 KV 缓存方法会产生实际较小的缓存，原则上可以减少解码内存和延迟。其他的，比如It is also important to distinguish algorithmic and theoretical cache reduction from systems-realizable cache reduction. Some KV cache methods produce an actual smaller cache that can, in principle, reduce decoding memory and latency. Others, such asKim et al. (2025, 2026)，通过从完整缓存中屏蔽或二次采样条目，或者通过在头和层之间使用非均匀逐出模式来评估。这些方法对于测量压缩缓存的质量很有用，但在没有尚未发布甚至实现的专用内核的情况下，它们不一定会转化为标准推理引擎中的挂钟加速或内存节省。, are evaluated by masking or subsampling entries from a full cache, or by using non-uniform eviction patterns across heads and layers. These approaches are useful for measuring the quality of a compressed cache, but they do not necessarily translate into wall-clock speedups or memory savings in standard inference engines without specialized kernels that have not been released or even implemented.

我们使用 KVPressWe use the KVPress(Devoto et al., 2025)SnapKV、KVzip、FastKVzip 和 Expected Attention 的实现。我们使用注意力匹配的官方实现。 我们进一步讨论所有基线implementation for SnapKV, KVzip, FastKVzip, and Expected Attention. We use the official implementation for Attention Matching. We discuss all baselines further inSection˜2和andAppendix˜B.

6.2 新的帕累托前沿A New Pareto Frontier

我们训练 LCLM 的压缩比为We train LCLMs with compression ratios of16×16\times, 8×8\times, 和, and4×4\times。在. InFigures˜1和and5，LCLM 在 RULER、LongBench 和 LongHealth 上的 KV 缓存压缩基线上建立了压缩时间和准确性的新帕累托前沿。 KV 缓存压缩方法在这些图中显示为几乎垂直的线，因为它们的压缩时间在很大程度上与目标压缩比无关。这些方法首先物化完整的KV缓存，然后执行逐出、屏蔽或压缩，其成本相对于全上下文预填充来说很小。相比之下，LCLM 在解码器预填充之前减少了序列长度，因此更高的压缩比直接减少了解码器端的计算量和内存量。, LCLMs establish a new Pareto frontier in compression time and accuracy over KV cache compression baselines on RULER, LongBench, and LongHealth. KV cache compression methods appear as nearly vertical lines in these plots because their compression time is largely independent of the target compression ratio. These methods first materialize the full KV cache and then perform eviction, masking, or compaction, whose cost is small relative to the full-context prefill. In contrast, LCLMs reduce the sequence length before decoder prefill, so higher compression ratios directly reduce the amount of decoder-side computation and memory.

时间和内存随上下文长度缩放。Time and memory scaling with context length. In Figure˜4，我们可视化了我们的方法的压缩时间和峰值 GPU 内存以及从 4K 到 1M 的上下文长度的基线。 LCLM 实现了最快的压缩时间，并且在较长的上下文长度下，显着降低了峰值 GPU 内存。 由于线性求解器的数值不稳定，注意力匹配在 1M 令牌时耗尽内存，并在 512K 令牌时失败。所有其他方法在 512K 和 1M 令牌时都会耗尽内存。 这种效率源于 LCLM 的两个属性：压缩是在固定大小的编码器窗口上执行的，而不是通过全上下文解码器预填充，并且编码器比解码器小得多。由于我们的编码器每次批量前向传递最多处理 128K 个输入标记，因此峰值内存最初由编码器激活控制。因此，峰值内存几乎保持不变, we visualize compression time and peak GPU memory for our method and the baselines across context lengths from 4K to 1M. LCLMs achieve the fastest compression time and, at longer context lengths, substantially lower peak GPU memory. Attention Matching runs out of memory at 1M tokens and fails at 512K tokens due to numerical instability in the linear solver. All other methods run out of memory at 512K and 1M tokens. This efficiency stems from two properties of LCLMs: compression is performed over fixed-size encoder windows rather than through a full-context decoder prefill, and the encoder is much smaller than the decoder. Since our encoder processes at most 128K input tokens per batched forward pass, peak memory is initially dominated by encoder activations. As a result, peak memory remains nearly flat for the16×16\times模型从 128K 到 512K 代币，并且对于model from 128K to 512K tokens, and for the8×8\times型号从 128K 到 256K 代币。在较长的上下文中，解码器预填充压缩的潜在序列成为主要的内存成本，导致峰值内存增加。model from 128K to 256K tokens. At longer contexts, the decoder prefill over the compressed latent sequence becomes the dominant memory cost, causing peak memory to increase.

细粒度压缩。Fine-Grained Compression. In Figure˜12，我们使用 GSM8K 来分析细粒度的压缩质量，其中我们压缩整个提示和上下文。 我们发现 LCLM 在 GSM8K 上的所有压缩比上实现了最高的精度，在较高压缩比下比基线有特别强劲的增益。, we use GSM8K to analyze fine-grained compression quality, where we compress the entire prompt and context. We find that LCLMs achieve the highest accuracy across all compression ratios on GSM8K, with particularly strong gains over baselines at higher compression ratios.

7 具有潜在上下文的代理脚手架Agent Scaffolding With Latent Context

代理系统通常用于处理大量信息Agentic systems are commonly used to handle large amounts of information(Zhang et al., 2025a)。 然而，代理通常依靠词汇或语义搜索来定位所需的信息。当在阅读信息之前搜索关键字不明显时，这些信息检索方法可能会失败。例如，在大型代码库中，“仪表板登录流程”中报告的错误实际上可能源于间接调用的权利模块，该模块从未提及“仪表板”或“登录”。理想情况下，代理应在采取行动之前立即读取所有信息，但现有模型的上下文限制阻止了这种情况的发生。. However, agents usually rely on lexical or semantic search to locate the information needed. These information retrieval methods can fail when the search keyword is not obvious before reading through the information. For example, in a large codebase, a bug reported in the “dashboard login flow” may actually originate in an indirectly called entitlement module that never mentions “dashboard” or “login”. Ideally, an agent should read all information at once before acting, but context limits of existing models prevent this from happening.

LCLM 更高效的长上下文能力使得将整个代码存储库放置在代理的上下文中成为可能。通过允许 LCLM 代理根据需要将压缩段扩展为原始文本，我们进一步增强了代理定位精确信息的能力。我们将输入分割成 512 个标记的固定大小块，压缩每个块，并为其分配一个整数标识符。该模型在一个提示中接收整个压缩序列，以及一个LCLMs’ more efficient long-context capacity makes it possible to place, for example, an entire code repository in an agent’s context. We further enhance the agent’s capability to locate precise information by allowing the LCLM agent to expand compressed segments into raw text on demand. We segment the input into fixed-size chunks of 512 tokens, compress each chunk, and assign it an integer identifier. The model receives the entire compressed sequence in a single prompt, together with one扩展EXPAND工具。在每一回合，模型都可以决定进行以下形式的工具调用tool. At each turn, the model can decide to make a tool call of the form扩展(i)EXPAND(i)，该工具将返回扩展片段的原始文本。, and the tool returns the original text of the expanded segment.

我们使用 RULER 中的大海捞针任务作为测试平台，用于评估这种具有潜在上下文的代理检索机制。如图所示We use the needle-in-a-haystack tasks from RULER as a testbed for evaluating this agentic retrieval mechanism with latent context. As shown inFigure˜6，我们的代理大大提高了原始 LCLM 的性能, our agent substantially improves performance over the raw LCLM with16×16\times压缩上下文，并且在某些设置中与原始未压缩上下文的性能相匹配。这些结果表明，压缩的潜在上下文可以提供广泛的语料库级别的可见性，而基于工具的扩展则提供所需的精确细粒度信息。这种最初的代理尝试的显着成功表明了适应性扩张的前景。 LCLM 可以在全局范围内浏览大量上下文，然后再决定放大哪个相关子集并更仔细地阅读。未来的工作可能会探索新的机制来确定要扩展的上下文或如何端到端地学习这种行为。compressed context, and in some settings matches the performance of the original uncompressed context. These results suggest that compressed latent context can provide broad corpus-level visibility, while tool-based expansion supplies the exact fine-grained information needed. The marked success of this initial agentic attempt suggests the promise of adaptive expansion. LCLMs can skim a large quantity of context globally before deciding which relevant subset to zoom in on and read more carefully. Future work may explore new mechanisms for determining which context to expand or how to learn this behavior end-to-end.

8 结论Conclusions

在长上下文基准、标准知识和指令跟踪任务以及代理设置中，我们的潜在上下文语言模型系列表明，学习压缩可以保留强大的上下文功能，同时提供显着的效率增益，使其成为高效长上下文系统的实用构建块。Across long-context benchmarks, standard knowledge and instruction-following tasks, and agentic settings, our family of Latent Context Language Models demonstrates that learned compression can preserve strong in-context capabilities while providing substantial efficiency gains, making it a practical building block for efficient long-context systems.

潜在上下文语言模型为未来的工作开辟了广阔的设计空间，并且与递归语言模型等代理框架自然兼容Latent Context Language Models open a broad design space for future work and are naturally compatible with agentic frameworks such as Recursive Language Models(Zhang et al., 2025a)。 更一般地说，LCLM 通过大幅减少输入的大小，为具有大量持久工作记忆的长视野智能体提供了一个有前景的基质。 LCLM 的未来迭代可以通过在多个粒度上压缩输入并根据信息密度或输入复杂度动态分配容量来进一步改善质量效率权衡。 这种自适应压缩可以允许模型在需要时保留细粒度的细节，同时保持紧凑的全局上下文，从而减少对显式扩展工具的依赖。另一个有前途的方向是将压缩范围从静态输入上下文扩展到模型的生成状态，包括长的思维链、工具观察和代理的累积工作历史，这些可以在长期任务中主导上下文预算。. More generally, LCLMs provide a promising substrate for long-horizon agents with large, persistent working memories by dramatically reducing the size of the inputs at scale. Future iterations of LCLMs could further improve the quality-efficiency trade-off by compressing inputs at multiple granularities and dynamically allocating capacity based on information density or input perplexity. Such adaptive compression could allow models to preserve fine-grained details where needed while maintaining a compact global context, reducing reliance on explicit expansion tools. Another promising direction is to extend compression beyond static input context to the model’s generated state, including long chain-of-thought, tool observations, and an agent’s accumulated working history, which can grow to dominate the context budget in long-horizon tasks.

附录AAppendix A影响报告Impact Statement

本文介绍的工作旨在推动机器学习领域的发展。我们的工作有许多潜在的社会后果，我们认为没有必要在此强调。This paper presents work whose goal is to advance the field of Machine Learning. There are many potential societal consequences of our work, none of which we feel must be highlighted here.

附录BAppendix B扩展相关工作Extended Related Work

硬令牌压缩。Hard-token compression.

硬令牌方法通过删除或重写输入令牌来实现压缩。 令牌修剪方法通过重要性启发法删除令牌Hard-token methods achieve compression by deleting or rewriting input tokens. Token pruning approaches remove tokens via importance heuristics(Li et al., 2023; Jiang et al., 2023, 2024)，而摘要和重写方法则通过释义为更少的标记来进行压缩, while summarization and rewriting methods compress by paraphrasing into fewer tokens(Chuang et al., 2024; Yoon et al., 2024)。 在实际应用中广泛使用的同时. While widely used in practice(e.g., context compaction in Claude Code and Codex; Anthropic, 2025; OpenAI, 2025)这些方法对于减少提示长度非常有效，但本质上是有损的：一旦信息在离散标记空间中被丢弃或解释，精确的词汇和结构细节就无法恢复。 这限制了它们在长视野设置中支持代码保真度、格式敏感推理和查找式上下文学习的能力。and very effective for reducing prompt length, these methods are intrinsically lossy: once information is dropped or paraphrased in the discrete token space, exact lexical and structural detail is unrecoverable. This limits their ability to support code fidelity, format-sensitive reasoning, and lookup-style in-context learning in long-horizon settings.

相关地，许多代理系统通过摘要、检索或结构化存储来外部化内存。 示例包括分层内存管理Relatedly, many agent systems externalize memory via summarization, retrieval, or structured stores. Examples include hierarchical memory management(Packer et al., 2023), 长期会话记忆, long-term conversational memory(Zhong et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2023)和代理记忆框架, and agentic memory frameworks(Xu et al., 2025)。 虽然可以有效地扩展交互范围，但这些方法通常依赖于基础模型外部的有损摘要或特定于任务的记忆表示。. While effective in extending interaction horizons, these approaches typically rely on lossy summaries or task-specific memory representations that are external to the base model.

KV缓存压缩。KV cache compression.

KV缓存压缩通过逐出条目来减少KV缓存的大小；大多数方法依赖于手工设计或学习的启发式方法来选择要删除的条目。 快照KVKV cache compression reduces the size of the KV cache by evicting entries; most methods rely on a hand-crafted or learned heuristic to select which entries to drop. SnapKV(Li et al., 2024c)通过在每个头的基础上删除具有低聚合查询关注度的条目来压缩缓存。 SnapKV 可以是与提示无关的（在不知道提示的情况下执行修剪），也可以是与提示相关的（在知道提示的情况下执行修剪）。 依赖于提示的方法的缺点是需要对上下文进行标记并提示输入，并且修剪对于每个单独的输入都是高度特定的，从而限制了多轮聊天的适用性compresses the cache by removing entries with low aggregated query attention on a per-head basis. SnapKV can be either prompt-agnostic, where pruning is performed without knowledge of the prompt, or prompt-dependent, where pruning is performed with knowledge of the prompt. Prompt-dependent methods have the downside of requiring labeling of the context and prompt for inputs, and pruning is highly specific to each individual input, limiting multi-turn chat applicability(Li et al., 2024b)。 为了克服这些限制，自学. To overcome these limitations, self-study(Zweiger et al., 2026)可用于从上下文本身生成合成查询信号，从而实现与提示无关的修剪，而不需要标记的提示上下文对。can be used to generate synthetic query signals from the context itself, enabling prompt-agnostic pruning without requiring labeled prompt-context pairs.

压缩包KVzip(Kim et al., 2025)通过使用教师强制的上下文重建作为代理目标来执行与查询无关的 KV 缓存压缩，根据重建过程中收到的最大关注度为每个 KV 对分配一个重要性分数，并修剪低分条目。 通过注意力匹配进行快速 KV 压缩performs query-agnostic KV cache compression by using teacher-forced context reconstruction as a proxy objective, assigning each KV pair an importance score from the maximum attention it receives during reconstruction, and pruning low-scoring entries. Fast KV Compaction via Attention Matching(Zweiger et al., 2026)通过拟合较小的一组键和值以及每个条目的偏差项来压缩 KV 缓存，这些偏差项与原始缓存的注意力输出和参考查询上的注意力质量相匹配。 预期关注compresses the KV cache by fitting a smaller set of keys and values, together with per-entry bias terms, that match the original cache’s attention outputs and attention mass on reference queries. Expected Attention(Devoto et al., 2025)通过用高斯分布近似未来的查询、以封闭形式计算每个键的预期注意力以及修剪具有最低预期贡献的条目来预测 KV 重要性。 还有许多其他 KV 缓存压缩技术，我们建议读者参考 Awesome KV 缓存压缩 Githubpredicts KV importance by approximating future queries with a Gaussian distribution, computing each key’s expected attention in closed form, and pruning entries with the lowest expected contribution. There are many other KV cache compression techniques and we refer the reader to Awesome KV cache Compression Github(Chen, 2023)进行全面审查。for a comprehensive review.

Li et al. (2024c)进一步注意，池化运算符的选择不会显着影响其性能。further note that the choice of pooling operator does not significantly impact their performance.

还可以针对特定提示进行离线定向 KV 缓存压缩。 此方法适用于逻辑上需要花费更多计算来压缩一次缓存的设置，因为此成本将分摊到许多用户查询上。It is also possible to do targeted KV cache compression offline for specific prompts. 软令牌压缩。Soft-token compression.

互补方向将长上下文编码为更少的学习连续标记。 软令牌压缩方法最成功的示例需要对目标上下文进行训练，例如前缀调整A complementary direction encodes long contexts into fewer learned continuous tokens. The most successful examples of soft-token approaches to compression require training on the target context, such as prefix tuning(Li and Liang, 2021; Mu et al., 2023; Tan et al., 2024)。 这些方法可以实现与基础模型相当的上下文性能，并且对于它们所训练的特定上下文具有较大的压缩比。 其他不需要对单个上下文进行训练的软令牌方法是上下文自动编码器. These methods can achieve comparable in-context performance to the base model with large compression ratios for the specific contexts they are trained on. Other soft-token approaches that do not require training on individual contexts are in-context autoencoders(Ge et al., 2023)和编码器-解码器压缩框架and encoder-decoder compression frameworks(Chevalier et al., 2023; Liao et al., 2025; Dai et al., 2025; Li et al., 2025).

高效的长序列建模。Efficient long sequence modeling.

互补的工作线通过修改底层序列模型、注意力机制或位置编码来降低长上下文推理的成本，而不是压缩输入。 早期工作通过段级循环和外部存储器将 Transformer 扩展到长输入：Transformer-XLA complementary line of work targets the cost of long-context inference by modifying the underlying sequence model, the attention mechanism, or the positional encoding, rather than compressing the input. Early work scales Transformers to long inputs through segment-level recurrence and external memory: Transformer-XL(Dai et al., 2019)缓存先前片段的隐藏状态以扩展有效感受野，并且压缩变压器caches hidden states from previous segments to extend the effective receptive field, and the Compressive Transformer(Rae et al., 2019)进一步将较旧的内存条目压缩为较小的压缩内存。further compresses older memory entries into a smaller compressed memory.

第二个方向用序列长度线性缩放的公式取代了 softmax 注意力。线性注意力变压器A second direction replaces softmax attention with formulations that scale linearly in sequence length. Linear-attention Transformers(Katharopoulos et al., 2020)将注意力集中作为内核特征图以获得cast attention as a kernel feature map to obtainO​(T)O(T)推理、状态空间模型，例如 S4inference, state-space models such as S4(Gu et al., 2021)和曼巴and Mamba(Gu and Dao, 2024)使用具有恒定大小隐藏状态的循环或选择性扫描公式，以及更新的混合公式，例如 Kimi Linearuse recurrent or selective-scan formulations with constant-size hidden state, and more recent hybrids such as Kimi Linear(Team et al., 2025)将线性注意力块与稀疏全注意力块交错以恢复远程召回，同时保持大部分每层成本线性。这些方法降低了注意力的渐近成本，但通常会牺牲检索式任务的精确远程回忆。interleave linear-attention blocks with sparse full-attention blocks to recover long-range recall while keeping most of the per-layer cost linear. These approaches lower the asymptotic cost of attention but typically trade off exact long-range recall on retrieval-style tasks.

在 Transformer 系列中，最近的 DeepSeek 模型压缩了注意力计算本身：DeepSeek-V2 中的多头潜在注意力Within the Transformer family, recent DeepSeek models compress the attention computation itself: Multi-head Latent Attention in DeepSeek-V2(Liu et al., 2024a)将键和值投影到低等级潜在 KV 缓存中，而 DeepSeek-V4projects keys and values into a low-rank latent KV cache, and DeepSeek-V4(DeepSeek-AI, 2026)引入了一种混合注意力架构，该架构交错压缩稀疏注意力（CSA），它整合了每个introduces a hybrid attention architecture that interleaves Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA), which consolidates everymm将 KV 缓存的 token 放入单个条目中，然后应用稀疏 top-tokens of the KV cache into a single entry and then applies sparse top-kk使用重度压缩注意力（HCA）对这些条目进行选择，它使用更大的压缩率selection over those entries, with Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA), which uses a much larger compression ratem′≫mm^{\prime}\gg m但保留了对结果条目的密集关注，共同减少了百万令牌上下文长度下的 KV 内存和每个令牌的注意力 FLOP。but retains dense attention over the resulting entries, jointly reducing both KV memory and per-token attention FLOPs at million-token context lengths.

单独的线程通过位置编码扩展预训练模型的可用上下文：旋转位置嵌入A separate thread extends the usable context of pre-trained models through their positional encoding: rotary position embeddings(Su et al., 2024)通过平滑外推提供相对关注，并且 YaRNprovide relative attention with smooth extrapolation, and YaRN(Peng et al., 2023)重新调整 RoPE 频率，以通过最少的额外训练来扩展上下文窗口。rescales RoPE frequencies to extend the context window with minimal additional training.

最后，并行上下文编码方法如CEPEFinally, parallel context encoding methods such as CEPE(Yen et al., 2024)采用不同的路线：小型编码器并行生成长上下文块的密集表示，冻结解码器通过插入的交叉注意层消耗它们，将长上下文暴露给解码器，而无需对原始标记进行完全自注意。take a different route: a small encoder produces dense representations of long-context chunks in parallel, and a frozen decoder consumes them through inserted cross-attention layers, exposing long contexts to the decoder without full self-attention over the raw tokens.

这些方法减少了每个令牌的注意力成本、位置索引的成本或自注意力所看到的有效序列长度，而不是到达解码器的令牌数量；它们在很大程度上与 LCLM 正交，并且原则上可以组合。These approaches reduce the per-token cost of attention, the cost of positional indexing, or the effective sequence length seen by self-attention, rather than the number of tokens reaching the decoder; they are largely orthogonal to LCLMs and can in principle be composed.

C.1 持续的预训练数据集管理Continual Pre-training Dataset Curation

在早期的实验中，我们仅对重建数据进行训练，并希望模型能够学习可概括的模式。然而，我们发现仅对此类数据进行训练就可以让模型以可忽略的损失重建完整序列，但它在重建类型任务之外的泛化能力很差。事实上，即使 LLM 解码器保持冻结状态，它也无法执行任何其他任务。这似乎并不奇怪，因为我们本质上是在执行通用版本的前缀调整。因此，学习到的表示虽然对于不同的上下文是通用的，但它却分解为重建的任务。另一方面，仅对下一个令牌预测进行训练使模型能够利用压缩上下文进行下游生成和推理。然而，所得的表示通常缺乏细粒度的保真度（例如，精确的字符串细节），导致重建较弱，并且需要精确恢复的任务变得脆弱。In early experiments, we only train on reconstruction data and hope the model can learn generalizable patterns. However, we find that training on such data alone allows the model to reconstruct the full sequence with negligible loss, but it generalizes poorly beyond reconstruction-style tasks. In fact, it cannot perform any other tasks, even when the LLM decoder is kept frozen. This might not seem surprising, as we are essentially performing a general version of prefix tuning. Thus, the learned representation, though general for different contexts, collapses to the task of reconstruction. On the other hand, training solely on next-token prediction enables the model to leverage compressed context for downstream generation and reasoning. However, the resulting representations often lack fine-grained fidelity (e.g., exact-string details), leading to weaker reconstruction and brittleness on tasks requiring precise recovery.

受这种权衡的激励，我们混合使用下一个标记预测和重建数据进行训练。我们的工作假设是，下一个令牌预测提供了与任务对齐的学习信号，指导解码器在压缩上下文上进行操作，而重建则充当辅助目标，鼓励信息保存并可以加速早期表示学习。理论上，单独足够大规模的下一个令牌训练就可以恢复细粒度的保真度，但我们发现在实践中，重建数据作为辅助数据源，加速了通用压缩器的训练。Motivated by this trade-off, we train on a mixture of next-token prediction and reconstruction data. Our working hypothesis is that next-token prediction provides task-aligned learning signals that teach the decoder to operate on compressed context, while reconstruction acts as an auxiliary objective that encourages information preservation and can accelerate early-stage representation learning. Theoretically, sufficiently large-scale next-token training alone may recover fine-grained fidelity, but we find that in practice, the reconstruction data serves as an auxiliary data source that accelerates the training of the general compressor.

策展。Curation.

我们的主要来源是 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 预训练数据集Our primary sources are NVIDIA’s Nemotron pre-training datasets(NVIDIA et al., 2025; Blakeman et al., 2025)。我们从 Nemotron 的预训练代码和 cc 代码中采样了 5000 万个数据点，从高质量和合成的高质量 cc 文本中采样了 5000 万个示例，从覆盖不同推理轨迹的 Nemotron 专用 SFT 混合物中采样了 5000 万个示例。 Nemotron 的合成数据的很大一部分由强大的教师模型（例如，. We sample 50M data points from Nemotron’s pre-training code and cc code, 50M examples from high-quality and synthetic high-quality cc text, and 50M examples from Nemotron specialized SFT mixtures that cover diverse reasoning traces. A substantial portion of the synthetic data from Nemotron consists of rewrites or generations produced by strong teacher models (e.g.,Qwen3-30B-A3B, Qwen3-235B-A22B (Yang et al., 2025), GPT-oss-120B (Agarwal et al., 2025), 和, andDeepSeek-R1 (Guo et al., 2025)），从而缓解遗忘问题。此外，为了使压缩器能够处理更长的文档，我们从 OLMo-3 longmino 集合中采样了大约 500K 个示例), which alleviate the problem of forgetting. Furthermore, to expose the compressor to longer documents, we sample approximately 500K examples from the OLMo-3 longmino collection(Olmo et al., 2025)。最后，为了更好地保留指令跟随和聊天模板行为，我们还包含 Nemotron 预训练 SFT 数据，并将其转换为标准化指令调整和多轮聊天格式。准确的数据集组成报告于. Finally, to better preserve instruction-following and chat-template behavior, we also include Nemotron pre-training SFT data and convert it into a standardized instruction tuning and multi-turn chat format. C.4 压缩数据格式Compression Data Format

持续的预训练。Continual pre-training.

对于连续的预训练数据，给定一个序列，我们将其分成多个段，用特殊标记包裹每个其他段For the continual pre-training data, given a sequence, we split it into multiple segments, wrap every other segment with the special tokens<|内存开始|><|memory_start|>和and<|内存结束|><|memory_end|>，并将包装的跨度视为压缩内容，同时保留其余段未压缩。, and treat the wrapped spans as compressed content while leaving the remaining segments uncompressed.

对于原始的预训练文档，我们构造了一个固定的交替模式的包裹和展开的片段，始终以包裹的片段开始并以展开的片段结束。超过 16,384 个 token 的文档保留 8,192 个可训练（未包装）的 token，而较短的文档则保留一半的可训练 token。段对的数量取决于文档长度：短于 2,048 个标记的文档接收 1 对； 2,048 到 4,096 个令牌之间的文档接收 1-2 对； 4,096 到 8,192 个代币之间的文档接收 2-4 对； 8,192 到 16,384 个令牌之间的文档接收 4-6 对；长度超过 16,384 个令牌的文档会收到 4-8 对。在每个序列中，第一个包装段包含总包装令牌的 30%-40%，最后一个未包装段包含总可训练令牌的 40%-50%，其余段分配有For raw pre-training documents, we construct a fixed alternating pattern of wrapped and unwrapped segments, always beginning with a wrapped segment and ending with an unwrapped segment. Documents longer than 16,384 tokens retain 8,192 trainable (unwrapped) tokens, while shorter documents retain half of their tokens as trainable. The number of segment pairs depends on document length: documents shorter than 2,048 tokens receive 1 pair; documents between 2,048 and 4,096 tokens receive 1-2 pairs; documents between 4,096 and 8,192 tokens receive 2-4 pairs; documents between 8,192 and 16,384 tokens receive 4-6 pairs; and documents longer than 16,384 tokens receive 4-8 pairs. Within each sequence, the first wrapped segment contains 30%-40% of the total wrapped tokens, the last unwrapped segment contains 40%-50% of the total trainable tokens, and the remaining segments are allocated with a±20%\pm 20\%抖动。任何段都不允许少于 128 个令牌。jitter. No segment is allowed to be shorter than 128 tokens.

指令调整。Instruction tuning.

对于会话数据，我们对每条消息独立地应用换行。整个消息内容有 50% 的概率包含在一对标签内。否则，以剩余 50% 的概率，我们在消息内插入 1-3 个包裹区域，并将剩余标记留在标签外。包装区域的数量取决于消息长度：短于 32 个令牌的消息始终完全包装； 32 到 200 个令牌之间的消息接收 1 个区域； 200 到 600 个令牌之间的消息接收 1-2 个区域； 600 代币或更多的消息接收 1-3 个区域。包裹区域总共覆盖了 80%-100% 的消息令牌，并且只要可行，我们就强制执行至少 5% 的未包裹间隙。如果实现的包装覆盖率低于 70%，我们将回退到完全包装消息。由于此决定是针对每条消息独立做出的，因此多轮对话自然包含完全包裹的轮次和具有较小未包裹跨度的轮次的混合，并且偏向于高整体覆盖率。For conversational data, we apply wrapping independently to each message. With 50% probability, the entire message content is enclosed within a single pair of tags. Otherwise, with the remaining 50% probability, we insert 1-3 wrapped regions inside the message and leave the remaining tokens outside the tags. The number of wrapped regions depends on message length: messages shorter than 32 tokens are always fully wrapped; messages between 32 and 200 tokens receive 1 region; messages between 200 and 600 tokens receive 1-2 regions; and messages of 600 tokens or more receive 1-3 regions. Wrapped regions cover 80%-100% of the message tokens in aggregate, and we enforce a minimum 5% unwrapped gap whenever feasible. If the realized wrapped coverage falls below 70%, we fall back to fully wrapping the message. Since this decision is made independently for each message, multi-turn conversations naturally contain a mixture of fully wrapped turns and turns with small unwrapped spans, with a bias toward high overall coverage.

E.2 左右扫描LR Sweep

语言模型在持续的预训练和 SFT 过程中很容易出现灾难性遗忘Language models are prone to catastrophic forgetting during continual pre-training and SFT(Luo et al., 2025; Li et al., 2024a)。为了主动避免遗忘，我们扫描了训练阶段 2 和 3 的峰值学习率。 为了测试灾难性遗忘，我们在 SFT 后对未压缩的语言模型进行基准测试，并检查其性能是否与训练前语言模型的基准性能相当。 对于第 2 阶段，我们从. To actively avoid forgetting, we sweep the peak learning rate for stages 2 and 3 of training. To test for catastrophic forgetting, we then benchmark the language model without compression after SFT and check that its performance is comparable to the benchmark performance of the language model before training. For stage 2, we sweep from1×10−61\times 10^{-6} to 1×10−51\times 10^{-5}并发现较大的学习率可以提高下游基准，而不会导致遗忘。我们将这些结果展示在and find that a larger learning rate improves downstream benchmarks without causing forgetting. We do not observe significant differences in those SFT LRs across different models; we report the detailed numbers on downstream benchmarks inSection˜G.3.

In contrast, the88B 解码器实现了显着较低的预训练损失，但没有产生我们预期的下游增益。 我们怀疑这部分是由于训练混合物和解码器初始化之间的不匹配：我们的数据管理和配方是围绕B decoder achieves substantially lower pre-training loss but does not yield the downstream gains we expected. E.4 打包序列Packed Sequences

由于我们的语料库包含许多长度可变的长上下文示例，因此传统批处理会在填充上浪费大量计算。为了提高训练吞吐量，我们将多个示例打包到一个序列中。因为我们不断地预训练指令调整的模型，所以我们通过重置示例边界处的注意掩模来防止跨示例信息泄漏，从而产生块对角注意模式。我们使用可变长度注意力内核有效地实现了这一点Since our corpus contains many long-context examples with highly variable lengths, conventional batching would waste substantial computation on padding. To improve training throughput, we pack multiple examples into a single sequence. Because we continually pre-train an instruction-tuned model, we prevent cross-example information leakage by resetting the attention mask at example boundaries, yielding a block-diagonal attention pattern. We implement this efficiently using variable-length attention kernels(Dao, 2023; Dong et al., 2024).
